Role & responsibilities




Job Title: AI/LLM Application Engineer

Location: Hyderabad, Chennai, Bangalore, Noida, Mumbai, Kolkata, Pune

Experience: 57 Years (Relevant: 5–7 Years)

Work Mode: 5 Days Onsite

Interview Process:

Level 1: Virtual
Level 2: Face-to-Face

Domain: Mining




Job Description:




We are looking for an experienced AI/LLM Application Engineer with 5–7 years of experience to design and develop enterprise-grade AI applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, LLM application development, Prompt Engineering, Azure AI Services, AI document extraction, Pydantic validation, MLflow, enterprise data integration, and OpenTelemetry. Experience in the Mining domain is preferred.

Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.

Mandatory Skills:

Python
Production-Grade Software Engineering
LLM Application Engineering
Prompt Engineering
AI Document Extraction Pipelines
Evaluation Frameworks
Structured Outputs
Pydantic Validation
Azure OpenAI
Azure AI Document Intelligence
Azure Machine Learning (Azure ML)
MLflow
Snowflake
Cosmos DB
SAP Integration
OpenTelemetry
Human-in-the-Loop AI Systems



Interested candidates please share your resume to lakshmi.b@tekskills.in
